features.name: The bottom five-module navigation
steps: Switch between "Alarm / Clock / Timer / Stopwatch / Bedtime"
The current tab is highlighted correctly
When returning to a module the existing data and state are preserved and not reset by page switching
features.expected: All five modules must be usable with mutually independent states; a running timer and stopwatch keep counting continuously after switching pages and returning, without resetting or being recreated; persistent data such as alarms and bedtime schedules must not be lost by switching pages.

features.name: Real-time clock and date display
steps: Open "Clock"
The current time keeps updating from the device time
The date and weekday change in sync
With "show time with seconds" enabled the seconds are displayed and update in real time
features.expected: The displayed time must match the device's system time and keep refreshing; the date and weekday must correspond to the device's current date; with "show seconds" enabled the seconds tick each second and are hidden when disabled; it updates automatically across minutes and days.

features.name: World clock / home time
steps: Manage additional time zones via "+" on the clock page
After saving it appears on the clock page
With "automatically show the time at your home location" enabled, whether the extra time is displayed is decided by the current and home time zones
features.expected: An added time zone must convert the time correctly for that city and refresh in sync with the device time; after deletion it immediately disappears from the list; the home time zone together with the auto-display toggle determines the display of additional time zones; the data must persist across restarts.

features.name: Alarm list and expansion state
steps: The alarm list shows several alarms at the same time
Each item shows the time, repeat days, and enabled state
Expanding an alarm shows its detailed settings
The configuration is preserved after collapsing
features.expected: Each alarm's time in the list must match its actual setting; the enabled and disabled states must be distinguishable without interfering with each other; expanding and collapsing must not lose edited configuration; multiple alarms' data are mutually independent.

features.name: Create a new alarm
steps: Tap "+"
Open the time picker
Choose the hour and minute
Confirm
The new alarm joins the list and is saved
It still exists after leaving the page and returning
features.expected: After confirming, the new alarm must immediately appear in the list with the time matching the selection; cancelling must not create an alarm; a new alarm is enabled by default and participates in the next-trigger computation; it still exists after leaving or restarting.

features.name: Two alarm time-input methods
steps: Open the time picker
The time can be chosen via a simulated clock dial
Switch to keyboard input mode and type the numbers directly
Cancel does not change the original value
Only Confirm updates the alarm
features.expected: The dial and keyboard input modes must show the same current value without losing it when switching; only Confirm writes back to the alarm and Cancel must keep the original value; an invalid time must not be confirmed.

features.name: Recurrence date rules
steps: Choose any combination from Monday to Sunday for the alarm
The list text generates summaries such as "every day / Mon–Fri / Sat, Sun" in sync
After changing the weekday the next trigger date is recomputed
features.expected: The selected weekdays must correspond one-to-one with the list summary text (e.g. Mon–Fri); the summary is derived from the weekday selection and must not be an independent field; after changing the weekdays the next trigger date must be recomputed; after all repeats are deselected it degrades to a single alarm.

features.name: Alarm enabling and next-trigger computation
steps: Enable the alarm
State persistence
The next valid trigger is computed from the current time, the alarm time, and the repeat weekdays
After disabling it no longer participates in the next alarm calculation
Re-enable and restore
features.expected: The displayed next trigger time must be later than the current time and match the recurrence rule; disabled alarms must not appear in the next-alarm notice; the enabled state must persist across restarts.

features.name: Alarm personalization
steps: Expand the alarm
Add/modify tags
Choose the ringtone
Toggle vibration
Return to the list
Reopening the same alarm keeps its configuration independently of other alarms
features.expected: Configurations such as tags, ringtones, and vibration must be bound to that alarm and persist; changing one alarm's ringtone must not affect other alarms; reopening the same alarm must show a configuration consistent with the list summary.

features.name: Temporarily pause a recurring alarm
steps: Choose "pause alarm" for a recurring alarm
Specify the start date and end date
The alarm does not trigger during the interval
After the interval ends the original recurrence rule is restored automatically rather than the alarm being deleted
features.expected: The alarm must not ring during the pause interval and the next trigger time must skip that interval; after the interval ends the original recurrence rule must be restored automatically rather than the alarm being deleted; the pause configuration must persist.

features.name: Delete the alarm
steps: Expand the specified alarm
Delete
Disappears from the list
It no longer participates in the next alarm calculation
Other alarms' order and state are unaffected
Re-entering the page keeps the deletion result
features.expected: Deletion must remove all of the alarm's configuration and it must no longer trigger; the other alarms' times, order, and enabled states stay unchanged; the deletion must persist and the alarm must not come back after re-entering the page or restarting.

features.name: Global alarm-behavior settings
steps: Change the ring duration, snooze duration, alarm volume, crescendo, and volume-key behavior in the settings
Settings persistence
All alarms use the new global behavior rather than only the current alarm being affected
features.expected: The modified global settings must apply to all alarms and not only the item being edited; they take effect immediately on subsequent ringing behavior; the configuration must persist across restarts and the settings must not override one another.

features.name: Timer numeric input
steps: Open the timer
Enter hours/minutes/seconds via the numeric keypad
Supports 00 and backspace
The input is mapped to HH:MM:SS in real time
An invalid or empty time must not start
features.expected: The input must carry over and display in real time according to HH:MM:SS rules; backspace deletes digit by digit without producing invalid values; Start should be unavailable when the duration is 0 or empty; out-of-range values must be clamped.

features.name: Full timer lifecycle
steps: Enter the time
Start
Count down by real time
The remaining time freezes after Pause
Resume continues
Switching to another tab and back still shows the correct remaining time
Reset/cancel restores the initial state
features.expected: The countdown must decrease by real elapsed time; the remaining time freezes after Pause and Resume continues from that value; after switching pages or returning the remaining time must not reset or jump; Reset restores the initial input state.

features.name: Timer completion feedback
steps: The timer reaches zero
Enter the completed state
The corresponding feedback is produced according to global settings such as "timer sound / crescendo / timer vibration"
The state is correctly cleaned up after the user dismisses the reminder
features.expected: On reaching zero the sound and vibration must trigger according to the global configuration and only once; the sound ends immediately when the user stops it; the timer returns to an initial state that allows re-entry and the completed state is still identifiable after switching pages.

features.name: Stopwatch lifecycle
steps: Tap start
The elapsed time keeps increasing
Timing stops when paused
Starting again continues from the original value
After Reset it returns to 00:00 rather than creating a new stopwatch instance
features.expected: The timing must accumulate by real time and not grow during a pause; Resume continues from the paused value; Reset returns to zero and clears records such as lap counts; the same instance keeps a continuous state without producing multiple stopwatches.

features.name: First-time bedtime setup: wake-up schedule
steps: Enter the first-time bedtime wizard
Set the wake-up time
Choose the enabled days of the week
Configure the sunrise alarm, ringtone, and vibration
These data are still preserved after the next step
features.expected: The wake-up time, enabled weekdays, ringtone, and vibration filled in during the wizard's steps must be saved and correctly reflected when moving back and forth; an unfinished wizard should not produce an incomplete bedtime schedule.

features.name: First-time bedtime setup: bedtime schedule
steps: Set the bedtime in the next step
Choose the effective weekdays
Based on "bedtime
The wake-up time automatically computes a sleep interval such as "8 hours
After changing either end time the duration is recomputed in sync
features.expected: The sleep duration must be derived automatically from the bedtime and wake-up times and recomputed immediately after changing either end; across midnight it must give the correct duration (23:00→07:00 is 8 hours); the bedtime and wake-up weekday settings are stored independently.

features.name: Bedtime reminder and bedtime mode
steps: Configure the "reminder 15 minutes before bedtime" and bedtime mode
The schedule enters the corresponding stage when the time window arrives
After changing the reminder lead time the next execution time is recomputed
features.expected: The reminder and bedtime mode must trigger at the correct point according to the configured lead time; after changing the lead time the next execution time changes in sync and must not keep the old value; it must not trigger early before the time.

features.name: Bedtime and wake-up alarm linkage
steps: Complete the bedtime schedule
The Bedtime home shows the schedule such as 23:00 / 07:00
The corresponding "wake-up" alarm appears on the alarm page
After changing the wake-up time in one, the other module syncs rather than producing two unrelated copies of data
features.expected: The wake-up time on the bedtime page and the alarm page must point to the same data, and changing either one syncs the other immediately; when the bedtime schedule is disabled the corresponding alarm state must be consistent; two contradictory records must not exist.

features.name: Bedtime activity data tracking
steps: The user chooses to keep enabling recent bedtime activity
The system forms activity/sleep estimates displayed by date based on device usage data
An empty-state notice is shown when there is no data
With data the chart replaces the empty state
features.expected: With no data an empty-state notice must be shown rather than a blank or broken chart; with data, activity/sleep estimates are presented by date and correspond to the selected time range; after disabling the feature the related entry should be hidden.

features.name: Bedtime home content visibility configuration
steps: Choose to hide recent activity, sleep sounds, or upcoming events from the more menu
The corresponding card is hidden from the Bedtime home
The other cards are preserved
Settings persist rather than being a one-off UI hide
features.expected: Hiding affects only the selected cards while the others stay as they are; the setting must persist and the cards stay hidden after a restart; re-enabling brings the cards back without losing their data.

features.name: Sleep-sound selection
steps: Enter "sleep sounds" from the bedtime page
Choose sounds such as waves / deep space / meditation from the device tones, or switch to another audio source
The current option is uniquely highlighted
The selection is still saved after returning
features.expected: Only one sound can be selected and highlighted at a time; switching the audio source changes the available list accordingly; the selection must persist across restarts; the actually played sound must match the selection.

features.name: Clock- and date-related global settings
steps: Change settings such as the clock style, showing seconds, home time zone, automatic home time, and first day of the week
After returning to the related modules the display and date logic change in sync
The configuration is preserved after a restart
features.expected: The clock style and showing seconds must affect the actual rendering of the clock page; the home time zone must affect the world clock's time offsets; the first day of the week must affect the calendar and recurrence arrangement; the configuration must persist across restarts.

features.name: Screensaver and general menu
steps: Enter the screensaver/settings/privacy policy/feedback/help from the three-dot menu
The screensaver runs with the saved style
Settings such as "night mode" change the screensaver behavior
After returning to the main screen the original module's state is preserved
features.expected: The screensaver must display according to the currently saved style and update with the clock; after changing options such as night mode the screensaver immediately adopts the new behavior; after exiting the screensaver the main UI's previous tab and running timing state stay unchanged.
